Every strategy that passes the lab gate is retested against stricter standards:
look-ahead information leakage, cost sensitivity, all parameter values, holdout that has never
been used for selection, different data frequencies, universe dependence, null tests, and correction
for the many combinations already tried.

done.300:
Status: strong if DSR is above 0,95 and both null tests are significant; moderate if
DSR is 0,90 to 0,95; weak if below that; leaky if the look-ahead test fails. DSR is the
probability of genuine edge after correction for having tested many combinations.
